thread:
dave: Heads-up — client QA hit an exception when the /v1/generate response had "tokens": null. Repro attached (node sdk).
anya: ugh. which client? is this new model or old?
dave: web-sdk v2.3.1. repro snippet: ```js
const res = await client.generate(...);
console.assert(Array.isArray(res.output.tokens), 'expected array');
// fails when tokens === null
```
mike: can we treat null === absent for that field? Historically some backends returned null for empty sequences.
kim: I want to avoid silent coercions. If our JSON schema says array, server should return [] not null. Consumers expect an array.
anya: Agreed. But we need to check backward compatibility for older clients that tolerate null. Risk: strict parsers (typescript runtime) crash.
dave: we should make a compatibility plan for callers. Repro shows only a few endpoints: /generate and /chat/complete.
ci-bot: build 2026-02-19-57 ran tests: 3 failures - sdk-integration-null-tokens.
mike: proposal: server invariant = never return null for repeated fields; map null -> [] server-side. Add a schema rule in our validator to reject null arrays at ingest.
kim: sounds fine. Also add Content-Type behavior note: for streaming NDJSON we emit `data: {...}` lines and each event must follow same non-null rule.
anya: one more nuance — structured outputs with content-type application/json+schema require that missing fields are treated as absent, not null. We should document preferred pattern: absent (omit) vs empty container ([]) vs null.
dave: action items: 1) mike to add server-side filter null->[] and unit tests (ETA 2 days). 2) anya to update SDK tolerant parsing and add integration test. 3) kim to add a short doc blurb in API contract section about null vs absent for arrays/objects.
mike: I'll open a PR with tests. Also will add a deprecation warning in logs for any backend that returns null so we can find stray nodes.
anya: For the rollout: canary on dedicated for 24h, then global. That should catch weirdness.
kim: Also add a lint rule in CI that runs the schema validator against representative responses (use schema v2.1).
dave: Can we add a query param for compatibility_mode=legacy that allows null for one week for emergency rollbacks? maybe overkill.
mike: I'd rather not add query knobs. Keep server consistent; if we need emergency fallback, use feature flag.
anya: OK. I'll add notes to the PR. cc @mike @kim @dave 
ci-bot: Created ticket #INF-1123 for server filter + tests.
dave: thanks all. I'll inform client QA and schedule a quick smoke test after the canary. :thumbsup:
